title: White Chocolate and Raspberry Mousse Bombes
changes_from_base: Individual white-chocolate shells replace the pistachio biscuit, filled with white chocolate mousse and frozen raspberries on a cocoa cake base, served on raspberry sauce.
summary: Individual white chocolate domes hide a raspberry-studded mousse and a disc of cocoa cake, served over a tart raspberry sauce.
equipment: 6-cavity silicone dome mould on a baking tray
round cutter the size of the domes
heatproof bowl over a pan of simmering water

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
beef gelatine powder, soaked in 2 tbsp cold water
fine sea salt or table salt
double cream, whipped to soft peaks and chilled

steps.title: Shell
steps.text: Brush tempered 115 g white chocolate evenly into each of 6 dome cavities right up to the rim, then chill until set.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C and line a large baking sheet; cream 225 g butter with 285 g caster sugar until light, beat in 2 eggs and 3 egg yolks one at a time, then alternate adding the sifted 55 g cocoa, 235 g flour, ½ tsp bicarbonate of soda, ½ tsp baking powder and ½ tsp salt with 240 ml buttermilk; spread evenly and bake for 15-20 min, turning halfway, until a skewer comes out clean.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool the cake for 15 min, turn out, peel off the paper, rest for 10 min, then cut 6 rounds the size of the dome openings.

steps.title: Melt
steps.text: Melt 150 g white chocolate over a pan of simmering water, then gradually stir in 55 ml double cream until smooth and warm; melt the soaked gelatine in short bursts and stir it in.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk 2 egg yolks with a pinch of salt, then whisk them gradually into the warm chocolate and keep whisking over the simmering water for 1 min before taking off the heat and cooling to room temperature.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Whisk the cooled mousse smooth, stir in a quarter of the 170 ml whipped cream to loosen it, then fold in the rest.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Pipe the mousse into the chocolate shells almost to the top, push 2 raspberries into each, smooth the surface, press on a cake round and freeze for at least 4 h.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Warm 450 g raspberries with 115 g caster sugar over low heat, stirring, until just simmering, then press through a fine sieve to remove the seeds and chill. To serve, swipe 1 tbsp sauce onto each plate, turn the bombes out of the mould and leave them for 20 min so the cake softens, then set them on the sauce.

tips: Temper the white chocolate properly so the shells release cleanly and have a good snap.
Use pasteurised egg yolks if serving anyone pregnant, very young, elderly or unwell, as the mousse yolks are only warmed, not fully cooked.
Check the pack of beef gelatine for its source if that matters to your guests.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: The extra cake keeps well wrapped in the freezer, and the finished bombes can be frozen for up to a week before serving.
